correctness.rationale: The claim has explicit integer and positivity hypotheses, temperature-one mean-zero normalization, exact Laplacian pseudoinverse/effective-resistance derivation, and two independent sharp extremizer arguments. Integer interval-count minimization and the strictly concave marker-gap potential prove the global maximizer and minimizer respectively, including equality/rotation classes and degenerate m=1 or n-1 boundaries. The claimed arithmetic gcd formula is derived from residues. Actual standalone program independently compared 4,048 rational arc/pair identities and all extrema, plus 238 exact covariance inversions; the analytic proof covers all n and all positive contrasts.

originality.rationale: The proposed theorem optimizes a fixed two-value edge-resistance inventory on every finite cycle and identifies both unique rotation classes and exact width gap. Ellens et al. (2011) establish total effective resistance and graph-topology optimization, not this constrained edge permutation theorem. Deng et al. (arXiv:2605.24479), inspected at its original PDF, optimize inserting a chord into weighted cycles and establish the covariance/Kirchhoff correspondence, but do not optimize the original cycle edge-weight order. Zhang and Yang (2007) address circulant graphs with unweighted edges, so their stated graph classes do not cover nonuniform stiffness placements. Own earlier research on fourth cumulants of heterogeneous periodic walks gives a quadratic primitive energy and a two-barrier placement result, but not the present all-inventory Gaussian-width minimizer and maximizer. Searches of published findings did not return a directly dominating result. The established energy formula and cyclic majorization principles are acknowledged; an undiscovered historical general weighted-cycle rearrangement theorem remains possible.
residual_risks: A historical rearrangement theorem for concave pairwise energies on finite cyclic groups or weighted Kirchhoff cycles could subsume the extremal ordering, even if not found in the present searches.
Zhang and Yang (2007) and the 1982 original source were only accessible at abstract level. Their complete texts were not used for a definitive global NOT_COVERING claim.
This is a structural exact finite-ring theorem; novelty assessment is best-knowledge, not exhaustive bibliographic certification.

value.rationale: The fixed inventory of two spring stiffnesses is a natural quenched-disorder design constraint for a harmonic crystal/linear stochastic interface. Mean-square roughness is a direct stationary physical observable. The theorem gives a complete all-size global extremizer classification and exact nonzero contrast gap, revealing a strong and non-obvious layout effect at fixed overall resistance; an exact all-composition classification, not an arbitrary finite numerical entry. It also distinguishes clustering from balanced placement in a way not determined by total stiffness inventory alone.
